title: Software
text: I build packages and tools to make data analysis more reproducible and efficient. Most are in R, with some Typst templates and Julia packages. Source is on GitHub; most of the R packages are on CRAN and r-universe.

title: Software
text:
Input–output analysis (R)

econio — input–output analysis
econiodatajp — ready-to-use Japanese input–output tables
econioread — read input–output tables
econagent — utility functions and composite goods in economics
ndgras — the nD-GRAS method (a multidimensional extension of RAS)

title: Software
text:
Japanese official statistics & geospatial data (R)

jpstat — tools for easy use of the e-Stat API
jpcity — read and convert Japanese municipality codes
jpgrid — functions for the Grid Square Codes (JIS X 0410)
jpmap — Japan maps with insets for Okinawa and Ogasawara

title: Software
text:
Data structures & tooling (R)

dibble — dimensional data frames
timbr — forest / tree data frames
stickyr — data frames with persistent columns and attributes
adverbial — enhanced partialised and composed functions
navigatr — navigation menu for pipe-friendly data processing
tarchives — make your targets pipelines into a package

title: Software
text:
Beyond R

traffic-jste (Typst) — unofficial template for Japan Society of Traffic Engineers (JSTE) manuscripts
TrafficAssign.jl (Julia) — traffic assignment

title: Uchida Mizuki
text:
Researcher · R package developer  /  Regional economics & input–output analysis
I work on research toward regional sustainability, and build open-source packages to make data analysis more reproducible and efficient.
Research  ·  Software  ·  Publications  ·  Contact

title: Research
text: I study how well regional economies can be measured from limited statistics as Japan’s population declines. For the figures used in practice — economic ripple effects, population and employment projections — I test statistically where they are reliable and where they are not, and release the methods as papers and R packages.

title: Research
text:
Estimating regional input–output tables
Municipal input–output tables can only be estimated from limited statistics. I validate the formulations of non-survey methods (LQ, CB) with regression analysis, and — jointly with Junji Nakazawa (Kochi University) — work on systematizing the balancing step of semi-survey methods that add partial field surveys.

title: Research
text:
Modeling interregional trade and migration
I estimate interregional trade flows and migration with gravity, radiation, and machine-learning models, and smooth observation-noisy data with empirical Bayes methods.

title: Research
text:
Supply constraints and regional sustainability
I work on the effects of supply-side constraints — from disasters or labor shortages — on regional economies, and on projecting industry-level employment (including tourism), toward assessing regional sustainability.
